Capacity, coverage, and assignments

• Spot patterns in the data (churn drivers, coverage gaps, capacity strain) and bring them to the team before they're asked for.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Identity and Access Management
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Come join the Identity & Access Management Platform team (IAM Platform) and build the layer that decides who can see and do what across all of ClickUp. This team owns the authorization engine, the permission and role model, authentication (SSO, MFA, SCIM, OAuth), sharing primitives, audit logs, and the core hierarchy data model and APIs that every other part of ClickUp is built on. It is backend-heavy, high-blast-radius work: a subtle mistake here is a security incident, not a bug report.

 

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help design and deliver an enterprise-grade access management platform. Right now that means building fine-grained, location-scoped permission profiles and inherited governance ceilings - a model where a workspace admin can delegate ownership of a Space to a local owner without letting them widen access, invite the wrong people, or delete the container, and where the effective answer is always the intersection of what a principal is granted and what every ancestor policy allows. You'll work on inheritance and resolution semantics across the Workspace → Space → Folder → List → Task tree, on the evaluation path that has to stay correct and fast on every request, and on migrating a live permission model used by millions of users without granting or revoking a single thing by accident. If you want access control to be the problem you work on rather than a checkbox on someone else's roadmap, this is the team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and build core services in ClickUp's authorization platform: the permission and role model, capability evaluation, sharing and access-control primitives, and the inheritance semantics that resolve effective access across the Workspace → Space → Folder → List → Task hierarchy.

- Extend the authorization engine to support configuration-driven enterprise access models - reusable permission profiles, atomic capability catalogs, delegated grant scopes, and inherited policy ceilings where restriction always wins over grant.

- Build and operate authentication and provisioning surfaces: SSO (SAML/OIDC, Okta, Entra, social IdPs), MFA/2FA, session and token lifecycle, OAuth and API token management, and SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning.

- Own the correctness of the permission evaluation path end to end - a single authoritative server-side decision that the API, the UI, automations, and agents all resolve against, with no bypass paths.

- Make access explainable and auditable: emit the events, reasoning, and audit trail that let an admin answer "why does this user have access here?" and "why was this share blocked?"

- Design and execute safe migrations on high-blast-radius data - shadow evaluation, dual reads, backfills, and staged rollout behind feature flags, with a verifiable guarantee that effective access does not silently change.

- Hold the performance and reliability bar for services on the hot path of every request in the product, and take part in the shared IAM on-call rotation.

- Partner with frontend, product, design, and infosec so the access controls we ship are precise, predictable, and usable by real enterprise admins - and represent your work credibly in enterprise security reviews.

- Work AI-natively: use AI tools and agents daily in your engineering workflow, and structure your work so agents can route, roll up, and report on it. We have no status-reporting meetings - reporting is self-serve.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience building production SaaS at scale.

- Hands-on experience building authorization or access-control systems - permission
